package.name: Forest Workshop
package.description: A portrait cozy workshop game in development. This 0.3 build adds residents registered from your characters and personas (with an optional language-model rebuild suggestion), your own uploaded resident pictures stored as WebP, pairs between any two residents, and backups that carry the pictures; production, invitations and stories follow. Install it, restart Marinara Engine when prompted, then open Home → 숲결 공방.
